source: dev-history.db (coins + outcomes pass 2 + v2_items), read by p1/gen-snapshots-v3.py
note: Point-in-time extract. Counts are arithmetic on the desk record; absence of a wallet means no launches in the desk record, not a finding. Methodology v2: 'harmfulExits' counts ADVERSE EXIT ITEMS — measured exit facts that also carry an aggravator under the published aggravator test (extraction + abandonment on the historical set; deception and hidden position unchecked where no printed-at-launch position exists). 'exitEvents' counts all measured exit facts, which carry no grade consequence by themselves. Exit items exist only where a disposal was measured (the pass-2 conduct set); absence of an item is absence of a measurement, not a clean finding. Snapshot format (Oct 21 2026 widening; the method did not change): names.json rows carry a fourth element, the coin's creator wallet (null where the desk record has none), and each key carries a 'coins' list of its mints in the name index — so any named coin resolves to its dev key from the published files alone. A names row may carry a fifth element, the integer 1, present exactly when the desk's LaunchLab ingest record shows the coin was born through the Launchkey FOUNDING config (pool-verified) — those are the coins whose public file this site serves; rows without it were born elsewhere and have no file here. A names row may also carry the coin's own desk record as a compact object (ath: all-time-high market cap in USD, three significant figures — for a graduated coin, an unrepaired recorded value below the validated $15K floor is a sampling artifact and prints as null, with the raw value preserved in the desk's audit log; a value repaired by the desk's ATH pass prints as repaired, since its peak was measured trade-by-trade from the chain and genuine low-value completions exist; end: the coin's mechanical ending under the published method, as a one-letter code — G graduated, Q quiet death, H harmful exit, A alive/open, U undetermined, R rug as recorded in the desk's first pass; born: birth timestamp; pair: the quote asset where the desk's pool-verified LaunchLab record carries one (P10-PAIR), else null), present where the desk record holds any of it. Key numbers are permanent identities, assigned once from the desk's registry and never moved or reused; they carry no rank meaning — the ladder's order is computed from the record, not from the number. Since Oct 22 2026 the grade floor also counts real graduations: a key with at least one graduation that did not round-trip to dust under the desk's peak-collapse test, and no adverse marks, grades at least PROVEN; a manufactured graduation counts for nothing. A key may carry a 'label' — the name and X handle the dev goes by: hand-verified for a few keys, otherwise the handle the key's own launches print in their metadata, the most frequent across those launches. Most keys carry no label and print as a bare key number. We verify records, not names: a label claims nothing about who controls a wallet. A key may carry 'linkedWallets' — launch wallets bound to the key by the key wallet's own signed attestation: coins those wallets launched at or after the attestation are credited to the key in these counts, and the signed messages are published in links.json so the link can be verified without trusting this snapshot. A launch made before its wallet's attestation is never re-credited; the link is printed on that coin's file as an annotation.
